title: Harry Reid's request for SAP status denied by William Lynn
summary: Eric Davis tells of Harry Reid's request for SAP status denied by William Lynn, about AAWSAP era (c. 2009) at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Harry Reid was trying to get deputy secretary defense William Lynn to give us an sap and William Lyn denied his request

plain: Eric Davis, who says he worked on a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained phenomena around 2009, says that Senator Harry Reid asked the deputy secretary of defense, William Lynn, to make their work a special access program, a tightly restricted category of secret project. According to Davis, Lynn turned down the request, which Reid had made in a letter, and if true it would mean the study was denied the highest level of secrecy and protection.
